applicable_when: The kernel performs a fused convolution bias-add: reads from a channels-last input (stride-1 within channel), adds a 32-element bias broadcast, and writes to an output with stride-256 between consecutive channel elements. This non-contiguous store pattern (x0 + 256*x1) causes L1TEX stalls on 39.3% of cycles. With only 1960 CTAs on 132 SMs (0.93 waves), the GPU is never fully occupied. Prior autotune attempts all failed correctness because they kept the hardcoded `xnumel = 250880` inside the kernel body (overriding the runtime argument) AND used a pre-computed grid tuple instead of a lambda. The fix is: (1) delete the hardcoded xnumel assignment inside the kernel, (2) use a lambda grid so autotune can substitute the chosen XBLOCK, (3) add @triton.autotune with multiple XBLOCK/num_warps configs.
